title: Missing required-field validation
description: A field the application declares or specifies as mandatory can be submitted empty (or whitespace-only) and the submission is accepted.
preconditions: A form whose submission can be observed
required_observations: required attribute, aria-required, or an explicit requirement naming the field
hypothesis_method: For each mandatory field, hypothesize that an empty/whitespace value is accepted by the layer that should reject it.
test_strategy: Submit the form with only that field empty; other fields valid. Test the browser layer and, separately and when authorized, the server layer (client validation disabled).
oracle_strategy: Browser layer: field validity valueMissing. Server layer: feedback attributable to the field after submission.
false_positive_warnings: Browser blocking proves nothing about the server
An unrelated error message (e.g. 'invalid credentials') is not evidence the rule is enforced
Optional fields may legitimately accept empty values
safety: Server-layer probes submit data: authorized/local targets only, within the mutation budget
confidence_requirements: Confirmed when the rule comes from a requirement or the browser layer is tested; server-layer failure against an HTML-declared rule is a likely defect.
limitations: Server persistence of the accepted record is not verified unless a follow-up observation exists

title: Incorrect minimum/maximum length handling
description: Values shorter than the minimum or longer than the maximum are accepted, or values at the boundary are rejected.
required_observations: minlength/maxlength attribute or a requirement stating the length rule
hypothesis_method: Off-by-one and missing-check hypotheses at each stated boundary.
test_strategy: Boundary values N-1, N, N+1 per limit; browser truncation observed via stored value length.
oracle_strategy: Value length after input (browser), field validity tooShort/tooLong, attributable feedback after submission (server).
false_positive_warnings: maxlength truncation is browser behaviour, not server validation
tooShort only triggers on user edits

title: Incorrect numeric or date range handling
description: Values outside declared min/max are accepted, or boundary values are rejected.
oracle_strategy: Field validity rangeUnderflow/rangeOverflow; server feedback when bypassed.
false_positive_warnings: step mismatch can make otherwise valid values invalid

title: Invalid format accepted
description: Values violating a declared format (pattern, email, URL) are accepted.
test_strategy: One clearly invalid and one valid representative per format.
oracle_strategy: Field validity patternMismatch/typeMismatch; server feedback when bypassed.
false_positive_warnings: type=tel does not imply a format
Email validity rules differ between browser and server

title: Cross-field inconsistency accepted
description: Fields that must agree (e.g. a value and its confirmation) are accepted when they differ.
required_observations: two fields whose names/labels mark one as the confirmation of the other
hypothesis_method: Field semantics ('confirm', 'repeat', 'retype', 'verify' + the same base term) imply equality.
test_strategy: Submit with all fields valid except the confirmation differing from its source.
oracle_strategy: Feedback attributable to the confirmation rule after submission.
false_positive_warnings: The pairing is a semantic inference unless a requirement states it: report as a likely defect

title: Incorrect checkbox / radio / selection requirement
description: A mandatory checkbox (e.g. terms acceptance), radio group or selection can be left unset.
test_strategy: Submit with the choice left unset; others valid.
oracle_strategy: valueMissing (browser) or attributable feedback (server, client validation disabled).

title: Client-side and server-side validation disagree
description: A constraint the page declares (HTML attributes) is enforced only by the browser; the server accepts the violating submission.
hypothesis_method: Every browser-enforced declaration is a claim about the application's rule; check whether the server enforces it.
test_strategy: Disable client validation for the field's form (noValidate) and submit one violating value per declared rule.
oracle_strategy: Feedback attributable to the field/rule after submission.
false_positive_warnings: Some servers normalise (truncate/trim) rather than reject
The HTML declaration may be stricter than the intended rule
confidence_requirements: Likely defect (not confirmed) unless a requirement states the same rule.

title: Validation feedback missing or misleading
description: A rejected submission gives no feedback, or feedback unrelated to the violated rule.
oracle_strategy: Attributable-feedback oracle distinguishes 'rejected for this rule' from unrelated errors.

title: Broken links, navigation and routing
description: Same-origin links or routes return errors or lose their landmarks.
test_strategy: Navigate to each observed route / link target; check status and stable landmarks.
oracle_strategy: HTTP document status < 400; headings seen on every earlier visit.
false_positive_warnings: Routes behind authentication redirect when the session is missing

title: Controls that do nothing or the wrong thing
description: Activating a control no longer produces the state transition observed during investigation.
test_strategy: Replay observed single-step transitions from a navigable source state.
oracle_strategy: Destination route or newly revealed landmark observed earlier.

title: Incorrect filtering, sorting or search
description: Results do not satisfy the applied filter or the stated ordering.
test_strategy: Apply observed options; check every record matches / records are ordered.
oracle_strategy: Metamorphic / invariant: filtered set ⊆ matching records; order monotone in the key the option names.
false_positive_warnings: Option semantics are inferred from labels

title: Incomplete create/update operations
description: A create or save submission does not reflect the submitted record.
test_strategy: Submit valid data with a unique marker; check the marker is shown.
oracle_strategy: Test-data echo (weak); persistence across reload needs a follow-up observation.
false_positive_warnings: Echo on the result page does not prove persistence

title: Broken multi-step workflow
description: A step of a multi-step flow (wizard, checkout) cannot be completed or loses earlier input.
test_strategy: Replay the observed step sequence; assert each observed destination.

title: Duplicate submissions / duplicate transactions
description: Repeating a submission creates duplicate effects where it should be idempotent.
test_strategy: Submit twice; compare collection size before/after.
safety: Only on targets where duplicate records are acceptable
limitations: Not automated: needs collection-size observation across routes

title: UI state disagrees with persisted state
description: An action reports success but the changed state is not visible after navigation or reload.
test_strategy: Perform the action, then revisit the record and compare its state.
limitations: Not automated: requires record identity tracking across pages

title: Incorrect derived values / rendering anomalies
description: Computed values render as NaN, undefined, [object Object] or raw exceptions after an interaction.
test_strategy: After every replayed interaction, scan the rendered text for anomaly tokens.
oracle_strategy: Generic invariant: such tokens never belong in user-facing text.

title: Incorrect counters, totals or summaries
description: Badges, counts or totals disagree with the items they summarize.

title: Incorrect login/logout or session handling
description: Valid credentials fail, invalid credentials succeed, or protected pages are reachable without a session.
test_strategy: Login with authorized credentials; empty submission; protected route without session.
oracle_strategy: Observed post-login landing route; observed validation message.
safety: Only authorized credentials; no credential guessing

title: Missing authorization enforcement
description: Protected functionality is reachable without the required role or session.
safety: Only within an explicitly approved scope; no privilege escalation attempts
limitations: Not automated: needs multiple authorized roles

title: Server errors and unhandled runtime exceptions
description: Interactions trigger HTTP 5xx documents or uncaught page errors.
oracle_strategy: Document status < 400 on navigation; investigation technical oracle for 5xx/console errors.

title: Missing accessible names and labels
description: Interactive controls expose no accessible name (label, aria-label, text).
test_strategy: Compute accessible names for controls on each observed route.
oracle_strategy: Heuristic accessible-name computation (not a full accessibility tree).
false_positive_warnings: Heuristic: labels associated by complex ARIA patterns may be missed

title: Keyboard navigation and focus problems
description: Controls are unreachable or unusable by keyboard; focus is lost or trapped.

title: Broken behaviour on refresh / back / repeated interaction
description: Reloading or navigating back loses or corrupts state.

title: File upload/download defects
description: Accepted file types/sizes disagree with declared constraints.
